mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, the temperature is 39 degrees with clear skies by the Verona Public Library. The overnight low will hit 32 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city is hosting a public meeting on December 8 at the Senior Center to discuss the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, including bridge replacements and future trail closures. Also, don't forget to check the Pellitteri website for your local recycling and refuse collection schedule.
There is a great lineup this week, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a report covering November 1 through November 15, police noted an incident on November 8 where a driver was arrested for O W I after striking a tree and light pole on South Main Street.
We hope you enjoyed today's Chocolate Volcano. The store is closed for the night, so join us tomorrow when we open at 10:00 AM and feature Caramel Turtle as the flavor of the day.
